sample_id with unresolved source material distinct from task material

invariants: One entity occupies only one physical location at a time
Every child has existing parent IDs and a causal create/modify receipt
State changes and repeated cycles do not mint new specimen IDs
A genuinely replaced sample gets a new ID; repeated attempts are not independent replicates
Hinge replacement preserves body ID and increments assembly_version with removed/new component parents; conditions cannot share records across versions
Array contains eight distinct unit IDs, each assigned once to a slot; unit membership forbids simultaneous standalone use
Raw records and failed attempts are append-only; derived records reference raw IDs and processing version
Repair or reset never erases prior damage, condition, failure or time history
Unknown historical reuse remains unknown; the episode explicitly declares its own reuse policy

identity_count_semantics.source_historical_specimen_counts: Generally not reported; second thicker array explicitly reported
identity_count_semantics.independent_specimen: A separately fabricated/allocated physical object with its own lineage; no minimum count invented
identity_count_semantics.repeated_state_attempt: Same specimen under a target/attempt condition
identity_count_semantics.cycle: One paired loading/unloading repetition in one run
identity_count_semantics.array_unit: Child structural unit inside an array, not independent experimental replicate
identity_count_semantics.displayed_configuration: Source target/view identifier, not specimen identity

repetition_policy: attempts_per_target, independent specimen allocations and total cycles are explicit task inputs; null blocks their expansion rather than inventing n. Source-required summary uses five cycles, not five specimens.
